verses.note: Genesis 15:6 says Abraham believed and it was counted to him as righteousness; this verse says he obeyed. James 2:21-23 reads the two together from Genesis 22: faith that is real acts, and Abraham's acts showed his faith complete.

Jacob has not yet called the LORD ‘my God’. The vow looks toward that confession, and 35:1-7 shows its fulfillment, when Jacob returns and builds an altar to the God who answered him in the day of his distress.
